sql: WITH impacts AS (SELECT edge_id,src_id,dst_id FROM rel_AFFECTS_CORE_SPEC UNION ALL SELECT edge_id,src_id,dst_id FROM rel_AFFECTS_TEST_SPEC UNION ALL SELECT edge_id,src_id,dst_id FROM rel_AFFECTS_OM_SPEC) SELECT c.node_id,c.tdocNumber,COUNT(r.edge_id) AS relationCount,COUNT(DISTINCT s.specNumber) AS specCount FROM CR c LEFT JOIN impacts r ON r.src_id=c.node_id LEFT JOIN Spec s ON s.node_id=r.dst_id GROUP BY c.node_id,c.tdocNumber ORDER BY relationCount DESC,c.tdocNumber
